---
title: Simulator Setup
---

Configure a desktop-first XR prototyping environment with the XR Blocks desktop simulator, including virtual hand tracking, plane detection debug visualizers, and navigation meshes.

### Desktop Controls

#### User Mode (Camera Navigation)

- **Move Camera:** Use <kbd>W</kbd>, <kbd>A</kbd>, <kbd>S</kbd>, <kbd>D</kbd> to move forward, left, backward, and right.
- **Elevate Camera:** Use <kbd>Q</kbd> and <kbd>E</kbd> to move down and up.
- **Rotate:** Right-click and drag the mouse to look around.
- **Switch Mode:** Click the on-screen mode toggle button or press <kbd>Tab</kbd> to switch to Hands Mode.

#### Hands Mode (Virtual Hands)

- **Move Active Hand:** Use <kbd>W</kbd>, <kbd>A</kbd>, <kbd>S</kbd>, <kbd>D</kbd> to translate the hand.
- **Elevate Active Hand:** Use <kbd>Q</kbd> and <kbd>E</kbd> to move the hand up and down.
- **Switch Hand:** Press <kbd>T</kbd> to toggle between the left and right hand.
- **Simulate Pinch:** Press <kbd>Space</kbd> or left-click to simulate a pinch/grab.
